name: Voice Fundamental Frequency
description: Analyzes voice F0 (fundamental frequency) patterns — voice cloning often has unnatural F0 contours.
mechanism:
This method analyzes voice fundamental frequency (F0) for deepfake detection:

1. **F0추출**: The fundamental frequency (pitch) of the voice is extracted per frame using autocorrelation, cepstral, or YIN algorithm. F0 corresponds to the vocal fold vibration rate, typically 85-180 Hz for males and 165-255 Hz for females.

2. **F0윤곽분석**: The temporal F0 contour (pitch track) is analyzed for naturalness. Natural speech shows characteristic F0 patterns: (a) declination (gradual F0 decrease across utterances), (b) prosodic contours (rises for questions, falls for statements), (c) micro-prosody (F0 perturbations at phoneme boundaries). AI voice synthesis may produce F0 contours with incorrect prosodic patterns or missing micro-prosodic detail.

3. **F0RangeandVariability**: Each speaker has a characteristic F0 range and variability. The method checks whether F0 statistics (mean, standard deviation, range) fall within physiologically plausible values for the apparent speaker. AI-generated voices may show either unnaturally constrained (monotone) or excessive F0 variability.

4. **JitterandShimmer**: Natural voice shows slight cycle-to-cycle F0 variation (jitter, typically <1%) and amplitude variation (shimmer, typically <3%). These micro-perturbations reflect the biomechanics of vocal fold vibration. AI voice synthesis may produce either too-perfect (zero jitter/shimmer) or incorrectly modeled perturbation patterns.

5. **F0-시각적상관**: Voice F0 should correlate with visible physical effort — higher pitch may correspond with increased tension visible in the neck muscles. The method checks audio-visual F0 correspondence. Deepfakes combining generated audio with generated video may show poor F0-visual correlation.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적
